meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 让它读取你的飞书日程与未完成待办，按指定日期汇总成一份摘要：日程表、待办清单、时间冲突提醒和空闲时段。运行前需有 lark-cli，并以 user 身份授权 calendar、task 权限。
howto.when: 当你说「今天有什么安排」「明天有什么会」等，或要求生成早报、开工摘要、查看本周安排时接管。仅支持 user 身份。

say.text: 帮我看看今天有什么安排
say.note: 输出今天的日程、待办与冲突提醒

say.text: 生成明天日程与未完成待办摘要
say.note: 日期需 AI 自行算成 ISO 8601 格式

say.text: 这周还有哪些安排？把无截止日期的待办也一起看
say.note: 不加 --due-end 时只展示近 30 天创建的

howto.what_en: Reads your Lark calendar and unfinished tasks, then summarizes a chosen date: schedule table, to-do list, conflict alerts, and free slots. Needs lark-cli installed and user-identity auth for calendar and task scopes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what's on today, tomorrow, or this week, or ask for a daily or standup summary. User identity only.

say_en.text: Show me what's on my schedule today
say_en.note: Lists today's events, tasks, and conflicts

say_en.text: Give me tomorrow's schedule and open tasks
say_en.note: Dates must be computed as ISO 8601

say_en.text: What's left this week, including undated tasks?
